source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 31 December 1927, p. 12 ("Larne Urban Re-elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: no valid nomination in any ward; the returning officer declared the retiring members re-elected: 'Central Ward, Mr. R. F. Greenlees [OCR CrreenlefV]; Curran Ward, Mr. Hugh Penney [Pennev]; Gardenmore Ward, Mr. Thomas M'Connell; Inver Ward, Mr. J. A. Liggate; and Townparks Ward, Mr. S. M'Meekin [M'Meekkw]' (BNL 31 Dec 1927 p. 12)

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, January 1928; there was no valid nomination in any ward, so the retiring members were declared elected (Belfast News-Letter, 31 December 1927, p. 12). Returned unopposed.
